name: presentation-diagnostics
description: The two product scenarios whose diagnostics INT-04 and INT-05 repair, each in a fresh process at the main menu with no save and no other mods. disposable-firearm-visual-rigs now reports the firearm item visual roster (the declared sixteen identities against what the game has) and every item's visual binding as two separate assertions. observe-gunslinger-presentation now reports the weapon census, the item census, the custom enchantment census, the policy-only enchantment and the player-facing text separately, and then their aggregate under its established name. A scenario may still fail on an assertion these changes do not touch; each assertion's own result is what is read.
